mission: Mission 3CY - PopSign fresh5 revised scratch architecture/input design review

head.subject: observer: CONTINUE - popsign fresh5 design review handoff

scope.purpose: State what a future scratch architecture/input route must change from the failed scratch_region_temporal_late_fusion_tcn_contract_v1 path and define gates before any later implementation, fitting, Brev, export, promotion, or recognition claim.

source_supported_observations: M3CX selected draft_revised_scratch_architecture_input_design_review_no_training and kept implementation, training, Brev, export, activation, promotion, source/data/tensor mutation, and final-gate changes unauthorized.

M3CR completed a 20-epoch LR 0.003 bounded local train-all with validation accuracy flat at 0.2, test top-1 0.2, macro F1 0.06666666666666668, validation/test top-1 morning:125, and final train accuracy 0.176.
M3CT found train, validation, and test logits all collapse to morning:125 top-1 and thank_you:125 top-2 with stable order morning > thank_you > who > pen > home.
M3CU found train linear_input_post_layernorm features nonseparable with variance mean 2.7852715663804345e-8, between/within centroid ratio 0.3116968095914498, and nearest-centroid accuracy 0.224.

M3CV localized collapse before LayerNorm/readout at head_input_fused_pre_layernorm with variance mean 0.00017123778903535984, between/within centroid ratio 0.3368962860376266, and nearest-centroid accuracy 0.176.
M3CK train-fit a deterministic one-clip-per-label microprobe to 1.0 accuracy, reducing total loader, label-index, gradient, and architecture-connectivity explanations.
M3CL-M3CQ reduce label-count, split leakage, source-label, tensor corruption, sampler/evaluator, optimizer/loss, checkpoint-selection, and threshold-only explanations.

Read-only code inspection shows the failed scratch_region_temporal_late_fusion_tcn_contract_v1 path consumes B,T,R,C,H,W, uses a shared scratch 2D frame-region encoder, per-region temporal blocks, temporal mean pooling, region attention after temporal pooling, and a LayerNorm plus linear head.
reviewer_inference: The failed path likely discarded or under-modeled discriminative motion/cross-region evidence before the classifier head: it compresses per-region temporal outputs by mean over time, then fuses regions late, after the model has already reduced each region stream to a compact vector.
The next route must not be another optimizer schedule over the same architecture/input envelope; it must change the design contract before any code or fitting is considered.

Current evidence cannot prove that the proposed revised design will learn, cannot isolate architecture capacity from input representation and data-diversity limits, and cannot authorize implementation or training.
A contract packet is still useful because it can bind shapes, allowed derived inputs, no-pretrained proof, browser budget, representation diagnostics, and stop gates before any code change.

failed_current_envelope.input_contract: rgb_regions preserved from T,R,H,W,C into B,T,R,C,H,W using five regions at 16x5x96x96x3 uint8.
failed_current_envelope.architecture_summary: Shared scratch 2D frame-region encoder; per-region temporal TCN blocks; temporal mean pooling per region; late region attention; LayerNorm plus linear classifier.
failed_current_envelope.observed_failure: Full balanced 125-clip train split did not form label-separating representations; train, validation, and test logits collapsed near-uniformly to one class.
old_contract_specific_weak_points_to_add: temporal mean pooling removes sequence evidence before class separation
region interaction happens too late and only after per-region temporal reduction
input lacks explicit motion/difference token contract despite signs being motion-sensitive
no predeclared representation-separability gates exist before train-all
the design did not create robust feature variance across labels under the tested train-all envelope

future_design_requirements.requirement: preserve time-region tokens until late classifier pooling
future_design_requirements.reason: M3CV shows fused head-input features are already collapsed; a future design must avoid early temporal and regional compression that prevents label separation.

future_design_requirements.requirement: model cross-region interaction before global pooling
future_design_requirements.reason: ASL signs can depend on both hands, body context, and relative motion; late scalar region attention after temporal reduction is too weak a contract after observed collapse.

future_design_requirements.requirement: include explicit motion evidence derived on the fly from existing approved tensors or define a separate future input contract before any tensor change
future_design_requirements.reason: The current input path is mechanically valid but not proven discriminative; a future route needs a motion-sensitive signal contract without media import or pseudo-labeling.

future_design_requirements.requirement: define representation diagnostics before any train-all run
future_design_requirements.reason: No future fitting should proceed without gates for train feature variance, between/within centroid ratio, prediction distribution, per-label recall, and non-collapse.

future_design_requirements.requirement: keep browser and privacy constraints first-class
future_design_requirements.reason: The model must remain from-scratch, browser-viable, and no-upload; architecture size and runtime must be bounded before implementation.

future_design_requirements.requirement: separate design contract, implementation scaffold, local smoke, and any paid compute receipt into separate milestones
future_design_requirements.reason: Current prompt authorizes design only; implementation and fitting require future review and approval gates.

ranked_revised_design_alternatives.name: scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract
ranked_revised_design_alternatives.summary: A from-scratch tokenized region-time model that consumes existing rgb_regions, derives bounded on-the-fly frame-difference/motion channels, keeps T x R tokens through temporal and cross-region blocks, then uses a learned class token or attention pooling only after interaction layers.
differs_from_failed_path: does not mean-pool temporal features before class evidence is formed
adds explicit motion tokens or frame-difference channels from existing tensors
models cross-region relationships before global pooling
requires representation-collapse diagnostics as part of the contract
ranked_revised_design_alternatives.why_ranked_here: It directly targets the M3CU/M3CV representation collapse while staying no-pretrained and potentially browser-bounded.
risks: higher implementation complexity than the failed late-fusion TCN
browser footprint must be proven before implementation
motion-derived input must be specified without mutating tensors unless later approved

ranked_revised_design_alternatives.name: scratch_motion_first_compact_temporal_cnn_contract
ranked_revised_design_alternatives.summary: A simpler from-scratch motion-first temporal CNN that uses appearance plus adjacent-frame differences over hand/body/full-frame regions, avoids early region mean pooling, and requires non-collapse train representation gates before any full-split run.
differs_from_failed_path: emphasizes motion deltas before spatial summarization
uses simpler temporal modules that may be easier to debug locally
ranked_revised_design_alternatives.why_ranked_here: It is less expressive but may be a pragmatic school-project route if the token design is too large.
risks: may still lack enough capacity for five-way signer variation
may not resolve crop/region semantics if input regions are insufficient

ranked_revised_design_alternatives.name: scratch_detector0_or_crop_normalization_prerequisite_contract
ranked_revised_design_alternatives.summary: A future route that treats crop/region target quality as the blocker and requires a scratch Detector 0 or crop-normalization contract before revisiting classification.
differs_from_failed_path: changes the upstream input target rather than only the classifier
would reduce dependence on fixed precomputed regions if approved later
could define hand/body localization as a separate scratch subproblem
ranked_revised_design_alternatives.why_ranked_here: It addresses input semantics, but it is larger, slower, and more likely to require human scope/code-path approval than a no-training classifier design contract.
risks: requires future implementation and possibly new data/annotation decisions

model_capacity.mitigation_gate: contract must set parameter/browser budget and require compile/no-grad shape plus parameter-count proof before implementation

temporal_modeling.mitigation_gate: contract must preserve temporal tokens and forbid early mean pooling as the primary class-evidence reducer

crop_region_semantics.mitigation_gate: contract must state whether it uses existing rgb_regions only, on-the-fly derived channels, or a later separate crop/Detector 0 prerequisite

data_volume_diversity.mitigation_gate: any future fitting route must define train-split non-collapse gates and stop before paid scaling if the 125-clip split remains nonseparable

optimization_signal.mitigation_gate: future receipt must predeclare optimizer schedule, checkpoint selection, and representation diagnostics before fitting

browser_footprint.mitigation_gate: contract must estimate parameter count, tensor shapes, browser memory/runtime constraints, and export feasibility before implementation

privacy_no_upload.mitigation_gate: route must keep normal practice local/browser-side and never upload raw learner video

source_legal.mitigation_gate: route must use only approved sources or require separate source/legal review before any expansion

school_deadline.mitigation_gate: if the next contract cannot produce bounded no-training gates quickly, pivot to product downscope/no-recognition rather than another model loop

before_implementation: shape contract for B,T,R,C,H,W and any on-the-fly derived motion channels
before_fitting: implementation scaffold compiled or dry-run only under a separate authorized prompt
predeclared optimizer, checkpoint selection, max runtime, output path, metrics, and stop gates
train feature variance, between/within ratio, prediction distribution, and per-label recall gates
explicit human approval if the route requires budget, source, tensor, crop, or code-path risk beyond the local no-spend envelope
before_brev_compute: fresh compute receipt with current human approval
command, max runtime/spend, kill condition, expected metric signal, artifact copyback, cleanup, and default-off plan
before_export_or_promotion: model-card and active-label promotion through repo scripts only

old_architecture_fitting_not_justified_n: M3CR already ran the bounded post-contract local train-all and did not improve over chance.
M3CT-M3CV show collapse is train-split and representation-level, not threshold-only, held-out-only, last-layer-only, or LayerNorm/readout-only.
M3CK-M3CQ reduce mechanical data, tensor, sampler, evaluator, optimizer, and source-label explanations.
A repeated fit under the same contract would spend time or compute without a new mechanism addressing representation collapse.

product_downscope_no_recognition.rationale: If the next no-training contract packet cannot state a bounded, browser-viable, no-pretrained path with evidence gates, the honest product move is a useful ASL learning surface with recognition explicitly fail-closed.

stop_scratch_recognizer_lane.rationale: A no-pretrained design route remains plausible enough for a contract packet. Stop becomes appropriate if the contract cannot avoid implementation, source, tensor, budget, or final-claim decisions.

cannot_infer_from_current_evidence: that any revised architecture will learn PopSign fresh5
that the fixed five-region input is sufficient without a revised input contract
that a Brev run would help before local no-training gates exist
that browser recognition or active labels can be promoted
that public dataset expansion or pseudo-labeling is allowed

decision.rationale: The design review identifies a defensible no-pretrained, browser-bounded direction that materially differs from the failed late-fusion TCN path, but only at design level. The next useful slice is a separate no-training contract/spec packet that binds the architecture_id, input_contract_id, shape/budget/no-pretrained/fail-closed gates, and representation diagnostics before any implementation or fitting can be considered.

commands_intentionally_not_run: tensor regeneration or manifest/source/register mutation commands
source import, media download, pseudo-labeling, or label expansion commands
export, browser activation, model-card promotion, active-label promotion, or final-gate commands
